---
name: Contribute a dataset
about: Offer fastener connection test data. We'll help convert it.
title: "New dataset: <first author> <year>"
labels: new-dataset
---

Thanks for offering your data! Fill in what you can. Rough answers are fine.

**Source:** paper, report, or thesis the tests come from (citation and link, if published)

**Tests:** how many, and what kind (fastener type and size, steel-to-steel or sheathing-to-steel, ply thicknesses, monotonic or cyclic)

**Data format:** spreadsheets, CSV, MATLAB, JSON, etc. Roughly how large?

**What's included:** force-displacement curves? Fastener details? Measured material properties?

**License:** how you'd like it shared (CC-BY-4.0 is the default here, so users must cite you)

**Would you like to:** [ ] convert it yourself with our help, or [ ] send the files and have us convert it
